_note: #403. A review is current only while the line it quotes is the reviewed document's one `Version:` line. a-old, b-old and c-old each quote a line that is written in their document and is not its version line: each is stale. b.md and c.md each have two lines starting `Version:`, so nothing says which is the version line: each document is a finding, and c-new, which quotes the newer of c.md's two, is not current either. d-current quotes d.md's one `Version:` line and has no finding: the control. e.md has no `Version:` line, so a review of it is read as before: e-line quotes a line of it and has no finding; e-word quotes a word that is in it and is no whole line, so it is not stale and its Supersedes: line retires nothing; e-older quotes a line that is not in it.

details.docs/reviews/a-old.md#provenance/stale: is not the Version: line of docs/specs/a.md
details.docs/reviews/e-word.md#provenance/supers: is not a whole line of docs/specs/e.md
